overview: Logisticians keep products moving from suppliers to customers. They plan shipments, manage vendors and subcontractors, track inventory and solve delays before they become problems. O*NET rates knowledge of transportation at 4.75 out of 5 for this job and administration at 3.96. Most logisticians hold a bachelor's degree, 75% in O*NET data, often in business or supply chain management. The BLS May 2025 median is $82,320 across 251,040 jobs, many in manufacturing, government and defense. The work is desk-based and deadline-driven, with lots of contact with customers and partners.
pay: Logisticians earn a median of $82,320, and the top 10% earn $133,160 or more. Washington has the highest state median at $107,250, 30% above the national figure, followed by the District of Columbia and Maryland, where defense logistics jobs are common. California has the most jobs, 32,940.

faq.a: The BLS May 2025 median is $82,320 a year. The lowest 10% earn under $50,890 and the top 10% earn $133,160 or more. Washington, DC and Maryland have the highest state medians, from $102,700 to $107,250, while Nebraska has the lowest at $65,370.

faq.q: What degree do you need to be a logistician?
faq.a: Most employers want a bachelor's degree. In O*NET data, 75% of logisticians hold one, and 8% each have a high school diploma, a certificate or some college. Related majors include business administration and supply chain management, and some people move up from warehouse or shipping roles.

It can be. O*NET data shows tight deadlines are common, ranking above 88% of U.S. jobs, and many logisticians work more than 40 hours a week. Problems with suppliers or shipping need quick fixes, so critical thinking is rated 4 out of 5.

faq.q: What is the next step up for logisticians?
faq.a: Transportation, storage and distribution managers are a 95% match and earn $107,230, 30% more. Purchasing Managers are an 87% match and earn $148,080, 80% more, according to BLS May 2025 data. Both reward supply chain experience, and many logisticians move into these roles after several years of managing vendors and shipments.
